tax.text: Leads a bipartisan bill to restore the state and local tax (SALT) deduction and calls cutting taxes for Long Islanders a top priority.
tax.quote: lowering costs and cutting taxes for hardworking Long Islanders is a top priority of mine in Congress.

immigration.text: Gillen made voting for the Laken Riley Act her first act in Congress and has pledged to push for tougher enforcement of immigration laws.
immigration.quote: I was proud to vote today for a bipartisan bill to keep our communities safe and deter crime.

guns.text: Backs comprehensive background checks and pledged to continue former Rep. Carolyn McCarthy's work against gun violence.
guns.quote: We must honor her legacy by continuing her life's work to keep our communities and our children safe from the scourge of gun violence.

abortion.text: Pledged to restore and codify reproductive freedom nationwide and criticized efforts to pass a national abortion ban.
abortion.quote: Since the disastrous Dobbs decision, we've seen nothing short of an all-out assault on our reproductive rights and freedoms, including Republican attempts to pass a national abortion ban while rolling back access to contraception and IVF.

health.text: Opposed Republican efforts to cut Medicaid and helped pass an extension of ACA premium tax credits to protect coverage.
health.quote: These cuts would devastate Nassau County: turning out seniors from nursing homes, raising costs for working families, and ripping veterans away from their health care.
